## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review ID and round: design-review-r5
- Judgment: approved
- Exact package: Design, System, Workflow and retained Target-Native Init at the four stored identities.
- Upstream basis: unchanged accepted proposal and independent proposal-review.
- Findings: no new material findings; des-review-f5 resolved by its original reporter. Previously resolved f1–f4 remain resolved.
- Applicability: current for this exact Design package.
- Isolation: reviewer records assessment only; no routing, Delivery allocation, implementation, adoption or publication claim.

## Whole-package assessment

The complete package and relevant source/consumer contracts were assessed during r4. Fresh subject inspection confirms the three living models are byte-identical; only the retained installer example presentation and ownership changed. The corrected six illustrations now satisfy PBF-R024's per-boundary requirement ownership, and the rejection, normal managed replacement, neighboring-content preservation, drift blocking, caught/interrupted recovery, idempotency and dry-run outcomes remain reviewable. The reviewer independently checked all six sets against every cited boundary rather than treating the weaker structural overlap validator as semantic approval.

The complete retained assessment supports one Design authoring contract, conditionally contained public methods/scaffolds, coherent System/component and shared-contract ownership, an exact bounded method/source/ADR migration map with retained decision meaning, preserved examples and proof intent, independent Review/Test ownership, declared coexistence/follow-up and withdrawal of competing invocations at coordinated adoption. The Design/Workflow mapping conflict is corrected. Managed installation now has an explicit narrowly authorized replacement/recovery contract owned by Target-Native Init rather than a manual pre-delete/hash-drift trap. This fourth member substantively amends the retained installation responsibility using scoped boundary-first-v1 for TNI-DES-01–06; it is not an installation-model migration, and the historical approval does not claim to assess it. No remaining material contradiction, missing direction decision or unassessable feasibility claim was found in this bounded package.

The earlier negative reviews and immutable origins remain historical. This fresh approval applies only to these current subjects and does not rewrite earlier review outcomes or establish implementation success.

## Reporter-owned resolution

Resolved by original reporter against current four-member package. E-DES-01 now cites02/04 with STATE/COMPOSE, both governing both; retired-inventory rejection has distinct E-DES-05 citing01 with INPUT/COMPOSE. E-DES-04 cites02/05 with STATE/TEMPORAL, both governing both; dry-run has E-DES-06 citing03 with AUTH/RECOVERY. All six example requirement sets were independently checked as subsets of every cited boundary governing set, beyond the validator overlap check. Representative outcomes remain intact; no fictitious boundary ownership, method change or implementation change was used.

## Verification and limits

Independently ran `python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --path docs/design/design/design.md --path docs/design/system/system.md --path docs/design/workflow/workflow.md --path specs/target-native-init.md`: passed structure/references, with no review_required. Independently checked the six example ownership rows using Python set containment for every cited boundary: passed. Compared the complete original installer contract body after Goal and context with git HEAD: byte-identical. `git diff --check` passed before recording; record-store validation and diff check run after saving.

Current author evidence records three-model prose pass, four-file readability pass with 241 warnings, and 79 resolving relative links. The full four-file prose check remains failed/current for 13 unchanged historical wrapping errors, with zero new findings in the recorded baseline comparison; this review does not claim that command passed. That unchanged historical formatting debt does not defeat the assessed substantive correction or justify rewriting unrelated historical examples. No installer execution, adapter generation, fault/recovery tests or measured performance were run or approved here. Delivery must allocate concrete local/integrated proof. Source-level assessment supports feasibility, not completed realization. Previous direct-source/no-project-map rationale remains.

## Independence provenance

Independent nonauthor task /root/independent_design_review retained the complete prior whole-package source assessment and independently reassessed the changed installer examples against the normative boundary method. Primary-agent authored all governed corrections. Reviewer authored no model/specification or implementation and changed no activity/routing. Author checks were supporting evidence, not independent approval.
